name: Skuerto
summary: Skuerto is a dwarven scout stationed at Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands. Sent there by Archmage Malin alongside Apprentice Kryten, he aids the Alliance in the field, helping secure magical relics on Malin's behalf.

sections.title: A Scout in the Highlands
sections.body: Skuerto, a dwarf of Ironforge, works as a scout in the dangerous Arathi Highlands. Stationed alongside Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe, he works under the direction of Archmage Malin to recover arcane reagents and potent magical artifacts that once belonged to Malin's old master, Archmage Trelane.

sections.title: Pride and Peril
sections.body: Despite the harsh conditions of the Highlands, Skuerto takes considerable pride in his wilderness scouting and reacts poorly to anyone questioning his competence. His work regularly brushes up against regional perils, from the hostile Syndicate and Boulderfist ogres to dangerous ancient entities tied to the land.

faq.q: Why is Skuerto stationed in Arathi instead of Ironforge?
faq.answer: Archmage Malin sent him. Skuerto and Apprentice Kryten were dispatched to Refuge Pointe to gather reagents and recover the items left behind by Malin's old master, Archmage Trelane, who fled Stromgarde when it fell under siege.

faq.q: What is Skuerto's mission at Refuge Pointe?
faq.answer: Archmage Malin sent Skuerto and Apprentice Kryten to the Arathi Highlands to collect arcane reagents and recover powerful magical artifacts once owned by Malin's former master, Archmage Trelane.

faq.q: Who are Skuerto's allies in the region?
faq.answer: He works directly with Apprentice Kryten, his partner on Archmage Malin's errand, and with the Alliance defenders holding Refuge Pointe.

angles.text: Skuerto exemplifies the grit of dwarves serving on the Alliance's wild frontiers, though his pride as a scout is easily bruised.
